Who We Are

Your Neighbors On The Roof — Not Storm Chasers

Crown Point Restorations was founded on a simple belief: your home deserves honest craftsmanship and a contractor who's still around long after the job is done. We're a locally owned and operated roofing company, not an out-of-town crew that disappears once the check clears.

  • Manufacturer-certified installers using premium, warrantied materials built to last decades.
  • Straight answers, fair pricing — a detailed written estimate before any work begins.
  • Fully licensed & insured for your complete peace of mind on every project.
Explore Our Services
100%Satisfaction Guaranteed
What We Do

Complete Roofing & Exterior Restoration

From a single leak to a full replacement after a storm, our crews handle it all with the same attention to detail — and we clean up like we were never there.

Roof Replacement

Full tear-off and re-roofing with architectural shingles, metal, or premium systems — engineered to protect your home for decades.

Roof Repair & Leaks

Fast, lasting fixes for leaks, missing shingles, flashing failures, and worn valleys — stopping small problems before they become big ones.

Storm & Hail Damage

Wind, hail, and fallen-limb damage restored fast — including emergency tarping to protect your home until the full repair is complete.

Free Roof Inspections

A thorough, no-pressure inspection with clear photos and an honest report — so you know exactly what your roof needs, and what it doesn't.

Insurance Claim Help

We document the damage, meet your adjuster on-site, and guide your claim from start to finish — so you get the roof you're entitled to.

The Crown Point Difference

Why Homeowners Choose Us

Plenty of companies can nail down shingles. Here's what sets a Crown Point roof apart from the rest.

01

Lifetime Workmanship Warranty

We stand behind every roof we install with an industry-leading workmanship warranty — not just the manufacturer's material coverage.

02

Local, Not Storm Chasers

We live and work here. When you need us in five years, we'll pick up the phone — unlike the out-of-town crews that vanish after a storm.

03

Insurance Claim Experts

Years of experience working alongside adjusters means we know how to document damage properly and get claims approved the first time.

04

Premium Materials Only

We install manufacturer-certified systems with real warranties — never cutting corners with bargain shingles that fail early.

05

Honest, Upfront Pricing

Detailed written estimates and no high-pressure sales tactics. If your roof doesn't need replacing, we'll tell you so.

06

Clean, Respectful Crews

We protect your landscaping, magnet-sweep for nails, and leave your property cleaner than we found it — every single time.

Storm Damage & Insurance Claims

We Handle The Claim, You Get The Roof

Filing a roofing insurance claim can feel overwhelming. Our team has years of hands-on experience working with insurance companies and adjusters — and we manage the process for you from the first inspection to the final nail.

1

Free Damage Inspection

We thoroughly document wind, hail, and storm damage with detailed photos and a written report.

2

We File & Meet Your Adjuster

We help you open the claim and meet your insurance adjuster on-site to make sure nothing gets missed.

3

Approved & Scheduled

Once approved, you typically pay only your deductible. We handle the rest and schedule your restoration.

4

Restored & Warrantied

Your new roof is installed to code, backed by our workmanship warranty, and built to last.

No Upfront Surprises

Think You Have Storm Damage?

Don't wait for a small leak to become a major repair. Most storm claims have a filing deadline — let us take a look before it's too late.

  • We work with all major insurance carriers
  • Free, no-obligation storm damage assessment
  • Guidance through every step of your claim
  • You typically pay only your deductible
